content_sections.body: B2 lesson 18 develops a controlled response to decision-making and counterpoints. Separate an observation from an inference, qualify the strength of a claim, and signal the reason for your position.
content_sections.title: Analytical focus

content_sections.body: In B2 lesson 18, a speaker presents one reason and a counterpoint about decision-making and counterpoints. The response acknowledges the point, adds evidence, and proposes a proportionate next step.
